question: The line pull's own count, and a retreat's destination.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_FillLinePositions(CAIUnit* agent, CList* positions, void* positionMap, int lineCount, int* alliedSoilBudget)
addresses.comment: **The line: divides the line count among the positions and marches committed divisions (+0x12C) into them.** 0x4C8EE0 to the `ret 0x14` at 0x4CA9BD (0x4CA9C0 abuts with no padding - trap 2). Records are the 0x1C CAIProvinceRecord. (A) small fronts: front provinces (+0xC0) whose area holds <= 3 provinces and fewer than 5 enemy land units, and that a committed division stands or heads in. (B) per position in a friendly-controlled province: have and standing zeroed; a province whose only front neighbour is a small front gets want = -1000 (left out); else cap = CAIUnit_GetPositionCap, want = trunc(lineCount x score / ops_area_score_total +0x34C) capped at cap, the remainders carried (0 where score < 1.0 and the total >= 1.0). (C) CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(+0x12C, divisions only, allies too). (D) Nothing given: every position wants 1, or 2 where the sum of CUnit +0xC0 over its province's units (CMapProvince +0x2B8) is above 0 (0x4C93F0-0x4C943E) - +0xC0 is the count of the CList at CUnit +0xB8, not the dig-in (+0x1C8), and no unit in the running game held an entry on it (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 102). Else while the carry > 0.1, the position with the least want (+100 where want + 1 would pass cap, first of equals) gets one. Then where want > trunc(3.5 x cap) and the province's supplies (+0x164) are nought or its supply need (+0x24C) is at least five times them, want is cut to that and the excess handed to the other positions up to their own 3.5 x cap. (E) each committed division not in a garrison (+0x2C9) and not airborne (CArmy +0x2FC == 8) while air transports exist: d = CUnit_GetPendingDestinationProvince (0x49B010). **With no d**, d = the province it stands in. **With d held by an enemy** (at war by +0xE28[controller]->+0x20, REB on either side, or an undeclared war covering it): the division is **passed over** when its path (+0x140) has fewer than 2 provinces - an attack on a neighbour is left to run - or when d's area (+0x2B4) is no real area (slot 0) or holds 3 provinces or fewer (+0x2C); otherwise it goes on below. **With d not an enemy's**: where it is not retreating (+0x158), holds ground (CUnit::IsHoldingGround) and d is not its own depot, MoveUnit(next step, or d when the path has one province, 0, 1, 1, 0) and the pass counts as having moved - and it **goes on below** all the same (0x8C9C62 falls through to 0x8C9C66). Below: it **stays** when d is a position whose want (+0xC) is above nought and whose standing (+0x14) is within its cap (+0x18) - not its have against its want - and, where d is a target-area province (+0x1CC), only while d is beside a hostile-route province (+0x1BC) (0x8C9C66-0x8C9DCF). **Otherwise it moves only where CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, strict, 0) allows it** (0x8C9DD5-0x8C9DFA, refused -> the per-unit continue at 0x8CA2B7), strict being the agent's own unit's (+0x64) oob_level (+0x1F4) other than 0 - every agent below a theatre - and the battle side not asked, so a division defending a battle is not held by the battle; then it goes to the position (have < cap) best by have/want x 100 (+ the excess over 1 again), at war x the distance and (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 where a land battle is on, x 0.66 at a depot, x 0.66 beside a hostile-route province, less 50 x the unit's defensive terrain modifier there (slot 89, GetUnitTerrainModifier(province, unit, false)), that it can reach (CMapProvince::CanUnitReach); failing one, to a second-ring province (+0xA0) picked by a MT19937 seeded with the unit's id. (F) each position still short pulls the division best by squared map distance x 16 + dig-in/100 + attack delay/1000 - 100 x its terrain modifier here (x 0.25 where its own position wants none, else + 100 x its terrain modifier where it is bound), able to reach and leave. **The pull's candidates** (0x8CA387-0x8CA4F3): not retreating, not a garrison, standing somewhere; d = 0x89AF00 (a destination, not read) or where it stands; where d is its own depot (+0x48 == +0xD0), not one 0x8AF4E0 answers true for (not read); with the allied-soil budget spent, not one CAIUnit_IsMoveFromHomeAreaToAlliedSoil (0x4C77C0) refuses; not airborne while air transports exist; not one holding ground (CUnit::IsHoldingGround) whose own province is a position that wants divisions - the map looked up through 0x8DCF30 is the function's third argument, positionMap, keyed by the unit's province (+0x130), and the test is the record's want (+0xC) above 0; and **not one whose d is held by a country it is at war with (CCountry::IsEnemy, 0x42F210) and lies beside the province it stands in, by any edge** - an attack under way. **The pull's fuller test** (0x8CA2C7-0x8CA74A): for the short position T, notDepot = 0 where T's province is its own depot (+0x48 == +0xD0), else 1, and T fill = (T.have + notDepot) / T.want in single precision. For each candidate, D = the position record of its d (null where d is no position); count = D.standing (+0x14) where the unit stands at d, else D.have (+0x10); the candidate is **taken without the test** where D is null, D.want <= 0, or (it does not stand at d, T.standing < 1 and it stands at T). Otherwise k = 0 where notDepot is 0, else 1 where T.have != 0 or count <= 1, else 0; and it is **passed over unless (count - k) / D.want > T fill**. Past that, where the agent +0x364 is set, the plan's stance (+0x64 -> +0x208) is below 2 and count <= D.want, it is passed over unless T is its own province's neighbour or a neighbour's neighbour - the edges of the province it stands in (+0xD4 -> +0x90, 0x14 a record), kind 3 skipped, each neighbour needing its +0x22 and +0x13D bytes set. The score is then x 0.25 where D.want < 1 - **D null included** - else + 100 x the unit's terrain modifier at d. **The best is kept by strict < and must pass CanUnitReach(T, unit, 1, 1) and CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, the agent's own unit's (+0x64) oob_level (+0x1F4) != 0, 0)**; once chosen: D.have - 1 and D.standing - 1 where D's province is where it stands (0x8CA8F1-0x8CA91D), 0x8C78E0(agent, T, unit, alliedSoilBudget) (not read), MoveUnit(unit, T, 0, 1, 1, 0), T.have + 1 and T.standing + 1 where T is where it stands, and the pull repeats while T.have < T.want. None left -> CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition. Every move is CEU3AI::MoveUnit(unit, province, 0, safe, very safe). See FINDINGS-moving.md, sections A.4, A.4b and A.4e. **On the listing, 2026-11-10: the carry leaves out a position scoring under 1.0 where the scores come to 1.0 or more, as the share does** (0x8C9480). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 16. **Both halves read on the listing, 2026-11-10.** The send walks the positions with a want and under their cap in list order: one where the division stands is taken at once, unless the division is bound for a target province away from the hostile routes, when only positions beside one are looked at. The key: have/want x 100, plus (have/want - 1) x 100 above 1; at war instead the distance **from where it is bound** x (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 for a land battle there; then less 50 x the terrain figure; then x 0.66 at a depot and x 0.66 beside a hostile route, all in single precision, from 1000000.0. The chosen is counted (the old record -1, standing too where it stood there; the new +1) and sent whatever MoveUnit answers. The pull's fill of the short position is worked out **once**, before its loop, and does not move as divisions are pulled to it; a candidate bound for its own depot under a blocking order (UnitHasBlockingOrder) is passed over. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 17. **Read live 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 60): the position list is the second argument ([ebp+0xC]), a chain of nodes holding the record at +0 and the next node at +8; at the pull's MoveUnit call (0x4CA945) the unit is in EDI, the target province in ESI, the target's record at [ebp-0x50]. The send's reach test, like the pull's, is CanUnitReach's land answer, the areas joined: Cdo. Sup. Africa's send left empty positions in Somalia to divisions in Eritrea and filled 9734 four deep instead. **Step (D) seen on the running game 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 69): Praha HQ, line 23 over 35 positions whose scores sum to 2090 against a best of 90, gave no position a share, so every one wanted 1; the two divisions standing on positions were then moved to their own provinces (caller 0x4CA94A), stopping them. **The second-ring branch read 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 91; 0x4CA1CF-0x4CA2B3): an MT19937 on the stack seeded with the unit's +0x14 (its save pair's serial, 6200 for a type-4713 unit, not a merged count), the first word tempered with arithmetic shifts, the signed remainder of the ring's size; the province drawn skipped where null or the one the division is bound for or stands in, else CanUnitReach(p, unit, 1, 1) and MoveUnit(unit, p, 0, 1, 1, 0), the line counted moved whatever MoveUnit posts. **The pull's count, read 2026-11-16** (FINDINGS-liveread.md section 110): the pull keeps its own count in [ebp-0x24], set from T.have (+0x10) as T's pull begins (0x4CA2F2). It is the T.have of the k term (0x4CA554), goes up by one after each MoveUnit (0x4CA964), and the pick repeats while it is below T.want (0x4CA96F); the record's own +0x10 (0x4CA952) does not steer the loop. No candidate test refuses a division whose destination is T, and the booking takes one off the candidate's own record D (found by walking the list for [ebp-0x3C]) with no test against T. So a division already pulled to T has D = T, passes the fuller test on T's live have, and its second pick takes one off T and puts one back: the pick is spent. Seen: Smolensk HQ's pull for 2390 at 10:00 on 16 July 1941 took the 124., the 111., the 31. and the 124. again. CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition is handed that count as its have (0x4CA977-0x4CA987).
addresses.evidence: Listing: mov edi,[eax+0x10]; mov [ebp-0x24],edi at 0x4CA2F2-0x4CA303; cmp [ebp-0x24],0 at 0x4CA554; mov eax,[ebp-0x24]; add eax,ecx; mov [ebp-0x24],eax; cmp eax,[ebp-0x34]; jl 0x4CA341 at 0x4CA964-0x4CA96F; push [ebp-0x34]; push [ebp-0x24]; push [ebp-0x14]; push [ebp+8]; call 0x4CA9C0 at 0x4CA977-0x4CA987. probes/hoiaimoves.lua on the recording wr10: four MoveUnit calls from 0x4CA94A into 2390 at tick 60807874, the 124. twice (+0x2CC 0, then 2390). Wrong if a pull is seen to stop short of want - its count's want - with candidates left.
addresses.revises: comment - the pull's own count, the re-pick, the reserve step's have

addresses.name: CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition(CAIUnit* agent, CMapProvince* province, int have, int want)
addresses.comment: **Held-back divisions to a line position nobody else can fill.** 0x4CA9C0 to the `ret 0x10` at 0x4CACAB (abuts 0x4C8EE0's `ret 0x14` with no padding - trap 2). One caller, CAIUnit_FillLinePositions (0x4CA987). Nothing unless the frontier is at war (+0x364) and divisions are held back (+0x15C). The shortfall is want - have; with have > 0 it is sent only where the province is beside a hostile-route province (+0x1BC) or has a land battle (slot 11 == 1) whose slot 17 (the attacker's share) is above 500 (g_AiAreaWeightFloor). Then, one division at a time while short: the held-back division not retreating, not standing on a front province (IsFrontProvince(false)), with strength >= 0.75 and organisation >= 0.9 (GetUnitAverageStrengthAndOrganisation), nearest within a map distance of 80, is taken off +0x15C, its ai_held_back (+0x2C8) cleared, and MoveUnit(unit, province, 0, 1, 1, 0). Answers whether it sent one. The name is ours. **Its `have` is the pull's own count** (FINDINGS-liveread.md section 110), not the record's +0x10: the count of picks the pull made, from T.have as it began.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4CA977-0x4CA987: mov edx,[ebp-0x34]; mov eax,[ebp-0x24]; mov ecx,[ebp-0x14]; push edx; push eax; push ecx; push [ebp+8]; call 0x4CA9C0.

struct_fields.name: movement_destination_province_id
struct_fields.comment: The id of the province the unit is moving to, resolved against the game state's province array by CUnit::GetMovementDestinationProvince (0x49AF00); zero when it is not moving. read. **A retreat sets it too** (seen 2026-11-16, writer not found; FINDINGS-liveread.md section 110): every retreating unit of one hour, four, had it equal to its path's last province, and CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions counted those bound for land no enemy holds nowhere. CEU3AI::MoveUnit writes it in the same pass (section 33).
struct_fields.evidence: At tick 60807891 on a run of Ireland1941_07_16_07: SOV 45. at 1630 2CC 1690 path end 1690, SOV 51. 2CC 1631 end 1631, SOV 105. 2CC 1690 end 1690, ITA 3rd Corps at 5552 2CC 5606 end 5606, each +0x158 set; the line's count at that hour gave 1630 standing 0. Wrong if a retreating unit is found with +0x2CC nought or other than its path's end.
struct_fields.revises: comment - a retreat sets it too
